# -------------------------------------------------
## Temporal trend of d15N vs. Assemblage novelty ##
# -------------------------------------------------

# ----- Fit Generalised Additive Models -----

# Homemade function

```{r}

# Homemade function to evaluate 'k':
evaluate_gam_k <- function(data, response, predictor, weight_var) {
  library(mgcv)
  
  results <- data.frame(
    k = integer(),
    edf = numeric(),
    k_index = numeric(),
    p_value = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  formula_base <- paste(response, "~ s(", predictor, ", bs='tp', k=%d)", sep = "")
  weights <- data[[weight_var]] / mean(data[[weight_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  for (k_val in 2:100) {
    cat("Fitting model with k =", k_val, "\n")
    
    model_formula <- as.formula(sprintf(formula_base, k_val))
    
    fit <- tryCatch(
      gam(model_formula, data = data, family = gaussian, method = "REML", weights = weights),
      error = function(e) {
        cat("Model failed for k =", k_val, "\n")
        return(NULL)
      }
    )
    
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      kcheck <- tryCatch(
        mgcv::k.check(fit),
        error = function(e) {
          cat("k.check failed for k =", k_val, "\n")
          return(NULL)
        }
      )
      
      if (!is.null(kcheck)) {
        edf_val <- sum(fit$edf)
        k_index <- kcheck[1, "k-index"]
        p_val <- kcheck[1, "p-value"]
        
        results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
          k = k_val,
          edf = edf_val,
          k_index = k_index,
          p_value = p_val
        ))
      } else {
        cat("No k.check returned for k =", k_val, "\n")
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}

```

```{r, Baiau Superior}

# Data frames:
ba_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";") 
ba_fp_beta_accum_q0 <- read.csv("Select your directory/Assemblage_novelty/ba_cumulative_beta_q0_sc98_nboot500.csv", sep = ";") # Assemblage novelty

# -------- Nitrogen --------

ba_raw_df <- ba_raw_df %>% 
  select(-Species_ID, -No) %>% 
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

ba_d15n_gam <- gam(d15N ~ s(mean.age, k = 32),
  data = ba_raw_df,
  family = "gaussian",
  method = "REML",
  weights = age.interval/mean(age.interval)) # Temporal-resolution weighting.

summary(ba_d15n_gam)
acf(residuals(ba_d15n_gam), main = "Autocorrelation of residuals") # Check for autocorrelation in the residuals
gam.check(ba_d15n_gam, rep = 500) 
appraise(ba_d15n_gam, method = 'simulate')

# -------- Assemblage novelty --------

ba.beta.accum.gam.table <- evaluate_gam_k(            # Compute all the models for choosing a suitable 'k'
  data = ba_fp_beta_accum_q0,
  response = "beta_q0",
  predictor = "mean.age",
  weight_var = "age.interval")

ba_accum_q0_gam <- gam(
  beta_q0 ~ s(mean.age, k = 16),
  data = ba_fp_beta_accum_q0,
  family = gaussian,
  method = "REML",
  weights = age.interval/mean(age.interval)
)

acf(residuals(ba_accum_q0_gam), main = "Autocorrelation of residuals")
gam.check(ba_accum_q0_gam)
ba_accum_q0_kcheck <- k.check(ba_accum_q0_gam)  # Generate a clean table to export
ba_accum_q0_kcheck

ba_assemblage_novelty_diagnostic <- appraise(ba_accum_q0_gam, method = 'simulate') +      #'gratia' package.
 plot_annotation(
  title = "Baiau Superior - Assemblage novelty"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )
ba_assemblage_novelty_diagnostic

# Summary table:
ba_accum_q0_gam_table <- tibble(
  Model = "Cumulative assemblage differentiation",
  Response = "beta_q0",
  Predictor = "mean.age",
  Basis = "tp",
  k = 16,
  edf = ba_accum_q0_gam_summary$s.table[1, "edf"],
  Ref_df = ba_accum_q0_gam_summary$s.table[1, "Ref.df"],
  F = ba_accum_q0_gam_summary$s.table[1, "F"],
  p_value = ba_accum_q0_gam_summary$s.table[1, "p-value"],
  Adj_r2 = ba_accum_q0_gam_summary$r.sq,
  Dev_exp = ba_accum_q0_gam_summary$dev.expl,
  k_index = ba_accum_q0_kcheck[1, "k-index"],
  k_p_value = ba_accum_q0_kcheck[1, "p-value"]
)

ba_accum_q0_gam_table

```

# Re-scaling the y-axis

```{r, Baiau Superior & Baiau Inferior}

# ------------------------------------------------
# ----- Calculate predictions for both lakes -----
# ------------------------------------------------

# In ggplot2, the secondary axis is not independent; it must be a mathematical transformation of the primary y-axis.

# ---- Baiau Superior ----

# Prediction grid:
ba_d15n_pred <- data.frame(            # Nitrogen predictions
  mean.age = seq(
    min(ba_raw_df$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(ba_raw_df$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

ba_accum_q0_pred <- tibble(           # Assemblage novelty predictions
  mean.age = seq(
    min(ba_fp_beta_accum_q0$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(ba_fp_beta_accum_q0$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

# GAM predictions
ba_d15n_fit <- predict(
  ba_d15n_gam,
  newdata = ba_d15n_pred,
  se.fit = TRUE
)

ba_d15n_pred <- ba_d15n_pred %>%
  mutate(
    fit = ba_d15n_fit$fit,
    se = ba_d15n_fit$se.fit,
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se
  )


ba_accum_q0_pred <- ba_accum_q0_pred %>%
  bind_cols(
    as_tibble(
      predict(
        ba_accum_q0_gam,
        newdata = ba_accum_q0_pred,
        se.fit = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se.fit,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se.fit
  )

# ---- Baiau Inferior ----

# Prediction grid:
bain_d15n_pred <- data.frame(            # Nitrogen predictions
  mean.age = seq(
    min(bain_raw_df$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(bain_raw_df$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

bain_accum_q0_pred <- tibble(           # Assemblage novelty predictions
  mean.age = seq(
    min(bain_fp_beta_accum_q0$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(bain_fp_beta_accum_q0$mean.age, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 300
  )
)

# GAM predictions
bain_d15n_fit <- predict(
  bain_d15n_gam,
  newdata = bain_d15n_pred,
  se.fit = TRUE
)

bain_d15n_pred <- bain_d15n_pred %>%
  mutate(
    fit = bain_d15n_fit$fit,
    se = bain_d15n_fit$se.fit,
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se
  )


bain_accum_q0_pred <- bain_accum_q0_pred %>%
  bind_cols(
    as_tibble(
      predict(
        bain_accum_q0_gam,
        newdata = bain_accum_q0_pred,
        se.fit = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se.fit,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se.fit
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# ----- Calculate common ranges for both lakes -----
# --------------------------------------------------

# Common δ15N range across both lakes:
d15n_range_common <- range(
  ba_raw_df$d15N,
  bain_raw_df$d15N,
  ba_d15n_pred$lower,
  ba_d15n_pred$upper,
  bain_d15n_pred$lower,
  bain_d15n_pred$upper,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Common assemblage novelty range across both lakes:
accum_range_common <- range(
  ba_fp_beta_accum_q0$beta_q0,
  bain_fp_beta_accum_q0$beta_q0,
  ba_accum_q0_pred$lower,
  ba_accum_q0_pred$upper,
  bain_accum_q0_pred$lower,
  bain_accum_q0_pred$upper,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# ----- Define common transformation functions -----
# --------------------------------------------------

# Assemblage novelty -> δ15N scale:
accum_to_d15n_common <- function(x) {
  (x - accum_range_common[1]) /
    diff(accum_range_common) *
    diff(d15n_range_common) +
    d15n_range_common[1]
}

# δ15N scale -> assemblage novelty:
d15n_to_accum_common <- function(x) {
  (x - d15n_range_common[1]) /
    diff(d15n_range_common) *
    diff(accum_range_common) +
    accum_range_common[1]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------
# ----- Re-scale assemblage novelty for both lakes -----
# ------------------------------------------------------

# Baiau Superior:
ba_accum_q0_pred_scaled <- ba_accum_q0_pred %>%
  mutate(
    fit_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(fit),
    lower_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(lower),
    upper_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(upper)
  )

ba_fp_beta_accum_q0_scaled <- ba_fp_beta_accum_q0 %>%
  mutate(
    beta_q0_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(beta_q0)
  )

# Baiau Inferior:
bain_accum_q0_pred_scaled <- bain_accum_q0_pred %>%
  mutate(
    fit_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(fit),
    lower_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(lower),
    upper_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(upper)
  )

bain_fp_beta_accum_q0_scaled <- bain_fp_beta_accum_q0 %>%
  mutate(
    beta_q0_scaled = accum_to_d15n_common(beta_q0)
  )

```

# Plot

```{r, Baiau Superior & Baiau Inferior}

# ------------ Baiau Superior ------------

ba_d15n_accum_overlap_plot <- ggplot() +
  
  # δ15N confidence interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = ba_d15n_pred,
    aes(x = mean.age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    alpha = 0.18,
    fill = "grey60"
  ) +
  
  # Assemblage novelty confidence interval, rescaled
  geom_ribbon(
    data = ba_accum_q0_pred_scaled,
    aes(x = mean.age, ymin = lower_scaled, ymax = upper_scaled),
    alpha = 0.18,
    fill = "#EC5757"
  ) +
  
  # δ15N fitted GAM
  geom_line(
    data = ba_d15n_pred,
    aes(x = mean.age, y = fit),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Assemblage novelty fitted GAM, rescaled
  geom_line(
    data = ba_accum_q0_pred_scaled,
    aes(x = mean.age, y = fit_scaled),
    linewidth = 1,
    colour = "#A70A0A"
  ) +
  
  # δ15N raw points
  geom_point(
    data = ba_raw_df,
    aes(x = mean.age, y = d15N),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.55,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  
  # Assemblage novelty raw points, rescaled
  geom_point(
    data = ba_fp_beta_accum_q0_scaled,
    aes(x = mean.age, y = beta_q0_scaled),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.55,
    colour = "#A70A0A"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_reverse(
    name = "Age (cal yr BP)",
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
    limits = c(7600, 0),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.03))
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
  name = expression(delta^15*N~("\u2030")),
  limits = d15n_range_common,
  breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08)),
  sec.axis = sec_axis(
    trans = ~ d15n_to_accum_common(.),
    name = "Assemblage novelty"
  )
) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Baiau Superior"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 6, 8)
  )

ba_d15n_accum_overlap_plot
```

# ---------------------------------
## d15N vs. C/N ratio comparison ##
# ---------------------------------

# --------------- Data treatment -----------------

```{r, Baiau Superior & Baiau Inferior}

# Data frames:
ba_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")
bain_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Unified_raw_dataframes/baiau_inferior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# ----- Baiau Superior -----

# Reduce dimension:
ba_raw_df <- ba_raw_df %>% 
  select(-Species_ID, -No) %>% 
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  mutate(              
    `C/N` = perc.C / perc.N        # C/N ratio calculation
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

# ----- Baiau Inferior -----

# Reduce dimension:
bain_raw_df <- bain_raw_df %>% 
  select(-Species_ID, -No) %>% 
  distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  group_by(sample) %>% 
  mutate(              
    `C/N` = perc.C / perc.N        # C/N ratio calculation
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()

```

```{r, Baiau Inferior}
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16), #Control for the labels of the axis.
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15), #Control for the ticks of the axis.
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),  # Legend title font size
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),   # Legend item labels
    legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "lines")     # Size of the legend boxes
    )

bain.cn.d15n

```

# Merge individual plots & Unify y-axis

```{r, Baiau Superior & Baiau Inferior}

# Force the plot to share the same y-axis:
shared_d15n_range <- range(
  c(ba_raw_df$d15N, bain_raw_df$d15N),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Apply the range:
ba.cn.d15n_shared <- ba.cn.d15n +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = shared_d15n_range)

bain.cn.d15n_shared <- bain.cn.d15n +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = shared_d15n_range)

# Merge both charts:
baiau_cn_d15n <- ba.cn.d15n_shared | bain.cn.d15n_shared
baiau_cn_d15n

```
